messages:
Lina: TriageBot alert: KV-cache paging rate spike + NCCL reconnects on tp-group alpha in eu-west-2. Observed client-facing streaming stalls (~1.5-3s) and increased 5xx on some dedicated tenants. tagging oncall @Omar.

TriageBot: [AUTOMATED] severity=sev-1; runbook=kv-cache-nccl-stalls; alert_id=KV-9921. paging metrics: per-shard > 80% read/write page faults.

Omar: Oncall here. pulling nvlink/NCCL dashboards. any recent config changes?

Lina: Yes — yesterday we flipped continuous_batching.batch_expand=true to reduce latency for short prompts. Change targeted at hosted but the flag leaked to dedicated via shared route config — looks like tp routing didn't rebalance.

Priya: customer-impact: CS reports 3 tenants with degraded streaming (partial tokens then pause). ticket numbers: TKT-443, TKT-444, TKT-446.

DevDeploy: I see a deploy at 03:07 that modified route flags for /v1/chat/stream. rolling back now to previous config.

Omar: Good. immediate mitigations: 1) disable continuous_batching globally for affected route, 2) throttle batch growth (set batch_token_cap=192), 3) reduce tp-node weight for the hot shard to force even mapping, 4) temporarily enable aggressive KV eviction on the hot worker.

Lina: Commands I'm about to run: `deployctl set-route /v1/chat/stream continuous_batching=false --env=prod`

(03:15) DevDeploy: rollback applied. route now returns `continuous_batching=false` to all Dedicated clusters.

Ops: I'm triggering eviction on tp-node-eu-3: `kvcache-ctl evict --node tp-node-eu-3 --target 30% --grace 30s`

(03:19) Ops: eviction started. per-shard cache entries for shard-7 dropping. paging IO latency reduced from 70ms->18ms.

Omar: Watching NCCL logs — nv_peer_retries spiked then dropped after eviction. still seeing occasional `NCCL WARN: Allgather hang` on tp-node-eu-3. planning to drain connections from that worker and restart tp process.

Lina: plan to drain gracefully: `tpctl drain --node tp-node-eu-3 --deadline=60s` then `systemctl restart redwood-tp` on that host. any objections?

Priya: no objections. let us know ETA so we can tell customers.

(03:28) Ops: drained and restarted tp process on tp-node-eu-3. quick sanity logs: `tp: startup complete, NCCL ready, KV-cache size=120MB`

Omar: NCCL hangs cleared after restart. tail lat p95 for streaming dropped to 420ms from 1.9s. error rate back to baseline.

Customer-Support: notified affected customers about mitigation at 03:32, offered temporary rate-limits to reduce workload while we validate.

Lina: root cause hypothesis: continuous_batching expansion + uneven KV-shard mapping led to one TP worker holding disproportionate KV entries; that worker saturated GPU interconnect/NCCL during allgathers, leading to stalls and increased paging.

Omar: Temporary follow-ups: 1) keep continuous_batching disabled for dedicated for 48h 2) add shard_balance alert if any shard > 2.5x median entries 3) add automatic throttling: if per-shard page_fault_rate > 50/min then cap batch expansion.

DevDeploy: PR opened to guardrail route flags so dedicated routes cannot inherit hosted-only batching flags: PR #3821.

Priya: ops doc note: add a checklist for draining and restarting tp nodes under kv pressure. linking runbook: https://intra/runbooks/kv-nccl-paging (will attach logs).

Omar: I'll also schedule a canary to re-enable batching at 1% traffic with strict per-shard caps and soft eviction. Lina can you own the canary?

Lina: can do. will create `canary/eu-batching-1pct.yaml` with caps `max_entries_per_shard=50000` and `batch_token_cap=128`.

(03:44) Ops: monitoring shows stable metrics for 10m. no NCCL warnings, per-shard eviction steady.

Customer-Support: customers acknowledged patch and will monitor. one tenant requested a postmortem summary for compliance — PR to include timeline and mitigations.

Omar: marking mitigated for now. incident-timer: reopened if we see page_fault_rate > 30/min or NCCL WARNs > 1/min. we'll run a full postmortem and include action items: deterministic shard mapping, route flag isolation, per-shard soft-limits, and automated eviction policy.

TriageBot: [AUTOMATED] incident state: mitigated -> open for review. incident_id=KV-9921. attach logs and thread to incident tracker.

Lina: thanks everyone. immediate owners: PR #3821 (DevDeploy), canary (Lina), shard mapping RFC (Omar). meeting set 11:00 to review postmortem and customer comms. :wave:
